text:
My

you

. My thirst. My eve. My

I-love-you

.

The dagger and the wound that holds it.

The answer I wait for when I call.

My apple of heaven and of earth.


My

forever-and-ever

. My thin water,

moaning and blue. My love and sign.

Endless skin. The estranged rose.

The hollow-eyed garden that dreams me.


Stellar insomnia. What remains to me.

The apple again. The thirst. The silk.

My heart without use of reason:


you are missing from me so much in this distance,

in the afternoon, at night, by day,

as my heart itself would be missing from me.

translation.title: Thirsty Sonnet
translation.editorial_note: This broken-line variant preserves the earlier English rendering while reflecting the source's fractured typography.
